fields.agencyOffice: Office of Cybersecurity, Energy Security, and Emergency Response (CESER)
fields.formName: Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report
fields.facility: Eastside 138 kV Substation; Energy Management System (EMS)

items.label: Criterion
items.value: Cyber event that causes interruptions of electrical system operations

items.label: Also met
items.value: Uncontrolled loss of 200 MW or more of firm system load for 15 minutes or more

items.label: Event type
items.value: Cyber event; physical equipment operated without authorization

fields.narrative: At 14:52 EDT system operators observed open commands issued from the EMS to breakers 4 and 7 at the Eastside 138 kV substation that no operator had issued. 212 MW of load was lost. Operators moved the substation to local control at 15:05 and disconnected the EMS from the corporate network at 15:11. A field crew is closing breakers manually. Investigation is in progress; this report will be updated within 72 hours.
fields.status: Received. A confirmation has been sent to the submitter. Submit an updated report within 72 hours and a final report when the event is resolved.
